final: WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, ab.translink, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, behavior_count, 1.0 * behavior_count / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS behavior_share FROM pair_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(behavior_count) AS avg_count_per_pair, AVG(behavior_share) AS avg_share_per_pair FROM pair_shares GROUP BY tradekind
